definitions.explanation: Cosmetic and beauty products, including skincare and makeup items. A shortened form of コスメティック.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧コスメ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}した→試す：02130_tamesu⟧。
⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コスメ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The cosmetics section at the department store is crowded.

examples.japanese: プチプラコスメ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many good-quality budget cosmetics too.

notes:
コスメ is a shortened form of コスメティック (cosmetic), widely used in everyday Japanese.

COMPOUNDS:
- コスメ⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: cosmetics counter/section
- プチプラコスメ: budget-priced cosmetics (プチプライス + コスメ)
- デパコス: department store cosmetics (⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧ + コスメ)
- ⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧コスメ: Korean cosmetics

USAGE:
コスメ is the standard casual term for beauty products in Japanese. It covers both skincare and makeup products. The word ⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧ is the more formal equivalent.
